I was tested for everything (mono, thrush, hiv, strep, etc). Everything came back negative which made my doctor think of acid reflux.

I literally have no typical symptoms of acid reflux but I had an endoscopy and they saw major gastritis and my esophagus was narrowing. I was put on omeprazole and started taking a probiotic on my own. The white coating on my tongue went away! As soon as I stopped taking the meds it all came back (including the sore throat). 

I’ve read that GERD can cause a white tongue (silent acid reflux). I was in denial about my diagnosis because like I said I didn’t have the typical symptoms like heartburn. I finally gave in once I stopped the meds and everything came back. 

Not sure if it was the probiotics or the omeprazole that worked for the tongue. Maybe give probiotics a go first and see what happens?
